name: worktree-diff
description: The worktree's changed files above the prompt; pick one and a Cursor-style editor opens in a pane with its code, its diff and its variables (.env).

editor.title: External editor
editor.description: The command that opens a file (the path is appended). E.g. open, open -a Warp, code -g, zed, cursor

background.title: Pane background
background.description: The pane's background color (hex or name). Empty uses the terminal's
